quiet_deadlines.description: For a stop that means no more turns: a session parked on a wake has no turn to cancel, so also record the stop on it. That wake's deadline then retires it without starting a turn, and the last one ends the session as cancelled; a delivery still wakes it. Omit to leave a parked session to end on its next wake, its deadline included.

turn_id.description: Omit to stop the current turn.
